Info

Factory service responsible for constructing pure Waypoint domain models.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.discretization.waypoint_factory.WaypointFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing construction of pure Waypoint domain model entities.

It defines:

methods:
create - Builds a Waypoint entity with explicit or default metadata.
classmethod create(*, x: float, y: float, z: float, speed: float, phi: float = 0.0, name: str = '', command: str = '') → Waypoint[source]¶

Constructs and returns an immutable Waypoint domain entity.

Parameters:

  • x – X Cartesian coordinate in mm.

  • y – Y Cartesian coordinate in mm.

  • z – Z height coordinate in mm.

  • speed – Motion feedrate speed in mm/s.

  • phi – Tool orientation angle in degrees (defaults to 0.0).

  • name – Optional waypoint identifier (defaults to empty string).

  • command – Optional protocol command string (defaults to empty string).

Returns:

Fully configured Waypoint domain entity.
